title.narrative: Integrated and inclusive life-saving response to critical protection needs of the most vulnerable groups for conflict affected populations in Northwest of Syria.

description.narrative:
The proposed action aim to provide inclusive lifesaving emergency response to the health critical needs of the affected population and improve the protection of the targeted population through community-based and individually targeted protection intervention which is aligned with the 2022 SA2 allocation strategy under envelop two that focusing on the provision of lifesaving humanitarian aid to the most vulnerable people and communities by improving the access to basic services, through integrated single and multi-sectoral activities.
The strategy of response is developed coherently with the strategic objectives (SO) of HRP 2023 as addressed below:
Protection biller: aligned with the protection SO1 that aims to improve the protection of affected population through community- based and individually targeted protection interventions and through advocacy and duty bearers HI will respond to the protection needs of conflict affected population in Northwest Syria (NWS) to enhance inclusion and accessibility of the humanitarian response through: - Delivering PSS services to groups and induvial in communities in the same communities targeted under Health to increase synergies and efficiency of the intervention - Provide case management personalized support to vulnerable individuals at the community level focusing on women, persons with disabilities, and persons of older age (while ensuring non-discrimination). - Increase access to services of the affected population through capacity development based of community/humanitarian actors and service providers - capacity development and empowering of persons with disabilities (including women) in the community to become self-advocates. - Conduction of community awareness sessions to increase understanding about disability and promote participation - Internal and external referral of cases towards existing specialized protection and assistance services to most vulnerable people and increase their access to the different services according to their needs in the area of HI intervention.
Taking into account key protection considerations following a gender, diversity and age informed approach, while focusing on high vulnerability groups, and strengthening inclusion of persons with disabilities.
HI will carry out its intervention by a gender balanced Inclusion and MHPSS teams each team consist of (1 female, 1 male). taking into consideration HI ensure through its intervention women's and girls' participation and empowerment, analyze and address barriers to accessible quality services and disaggregate data by disability, gender, age and other relevant factors for monitoring inclusion. Moreover, HI ensures a systematic mainstreaming of the interests of women and girls with disabilities across its action plans, strategies, policies and programs.
